title: Share Trading Policy

tiers.name: SEEK Personnel
tiers.description: All officers, employees and contractors of SEEK and its subsidiaries. Subject only to the insider trading prohibition in section 2; the blackout, clearance, hedging, margin loan, short selling and short-term dealing restrictions do not apply to them unless they are also Designated Persons.

tiers.name: Designated Persons
tiers.description: Persons specified in the Annexure: Directors, members of the Executive Leadership Team (and their Executive Assistants), the Finance and Business Services Leadership Team, SEEK Growth Fund personnel, participants in the SEEK Wealth Sharing Plan, Executive Equity Plan, Restricted Rights Plan and Performance Rights Plan, named finance/legal/governance/IR/risk/communications teams, and anyone else with access to Inside Information as specified by the Company Secretary. Bears the blackout, clearance, hedging, short selling and short-term dealing restrictions.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of SEEK. Clear with the Chairman (the Chairman clears with the ARMC Chairman), must give post-dealing written notice to the Company Secretary, and are one of only two groups subject to the margin loan / security arrangement clearance requirement in section 5(A).

tiers.name: Members of the Executive Leadership Team
tiers.description: ELT members. Clear with the CEO (the CEO clears with the Chairman) and, with Directors, are subject to the section 5(A) margin loan and security arrangement clearance requirement and consequent materiality review by the Disclosure Committee.

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: Spouse or partner, child or step-child, a relative sharing the household for 12 months, entities of which the Designated Person is a director/secretary/executive officer (absent screening arrangements), companies where the person holds or controls at least 20 per cent, trustees of trusts benefiting the person or their spouse/partner/children, and any person over whom the Designated Person has investment control or influence.

definitions.hedging_definition: arrangements which have the effect of limiting the economic risk related to an unvested share, option or other Security granted or awarded under a SEEK employee incentive scheme (or a vested share, option or other Security granted, awarded or acquired under a SEEK employee incentive scheme that is still subject to disposal restrictions)

windows.end_anchor: one Trading Day following the announcement of the half year results
one Trading Day following the announcement of the full year results

windows.start_anchor: two weeks prior to the date of SEEK's Annual General Meeting
windows.end_anchor: one Trading Day after the Annual General Meeting

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The SEEK Company Secretary may notify persons that they are Designated Persons for the purposes of any extended or additional period, which then forms part of the Blackout Periods. The policy does not state whether such a period is announced or confidential, but a refusal of clearance must be kept confidential by the person refused.

rules.detail: Derivatives are not separately regulated. 'Securities' expressly includes any derivatives including options in respect of shares, with no venue limitation, so writing a call or buying a put over SEEK shares with a bank is dealing in SEEK Securities: it needs prior written clearance from the relevant approver, must occur within 5 Trading Days of clearance, is barred in Blackout Periods absent exceptional circumstances, and is barred while holding Inside Information.
rules.evidence: Securities includes, without limitation: ... any derivatives including but not limited to options in respect of any of (a) to (d) above

rules.detail: SEEK Personnel who are not Designated Persons face no clearance or blackout restriction; only the insider trading prohibition applies, so derivatives over SEEK Securities are unrestricted provided they hold no Inside Information.
rules.evidence: In addition to the Insider Trading prohibitions set out in this Policy which apply to all SEEK Personnel, additional restrictions on dealing in SEEK Securities apply to Designated Persons who are specified in the Annexure to this Policy (and their Associates).

rules.detail: Absolute ban, with no clearance route, on any arrangement limiting the economic risk of an unvested share, option or other Security granted or awarded under a SEEK employee incentive scheme.
rules.evidence: SEEK prohibits Designated Persons from entering into arrangements which have the effect of limiting the economic risk related to an unvested share, option or other Security granted or awarded under a SEEK employee incentive scheme

rules.detail: The ban expressly extends to vested plan securities that remain subject to disposal restrictions, so shares vested but still in a holding lock or restriction period cannot be collared.
rules.evidence: (or a vested share, option or other Security granted, awarded or acquired under a SEEK employee incentive scheme that is still subject to disposal restrictions)

rules.detail: The hedging ban is confined to unvested plan securities and vested plan securities still subject to disposal restrictions. Hedging vested, unrestricted shares (whether plan-derived or bought on market) is not prohibited, but the hedge is itself dealing in Securities and so requires prior written clearance, execution within 5 Trading Days, and an open period.
rules.evidence: SEEK prohibits Designated Persons from entering into arrangements which have the effect of limiting the economic risk related to an unvested share, option or other Security granted or awarded under a SEEK employee incentive scheme

rules.detail: Monetisation, prepaid forwards and collar-plus-loan structures are not named. Each leg is a dealing in SEEK Securities (or in derivatives over them), and for Directors and ELT any security taken over the shares also engages section 5(A). Clearance from the relevant approver is therefore required for entry, and again for any unwind or physical settlement.
rules.evidence: Dealing in SEEK Securities by Designated Persons outside the Blackout Periods set out in section 3(A) above, is only permitted: (a) if the Designated Person is not, at the time of the proposed dealing, in possession of any Inside Information

rules.detail: Outright ban at any time, with no clearance route. A collar over shares the executive actually owns is covered rather than naked, but any leg that leaves the person net short of shares they do not hold would breach this.
rules.evidence: engage in short selling SEEK Securities at any time.

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named anywhere in the Policy and is not brought in by any definition. A lend that transfers title would, however, be a change in beneficial control and so a dealing requiring clearance.

CFDs are not named. A CFD over SEEK shares is a derivative in respect of shares and so a Security, making it a dealing that needs clearance; a short CFD would breach the absolute short selling ban and a CFD closed out within three months would engage the short-term dealing restriction.
rules.evidence: any derivatives including but not limited to options in respect of any of (a) to (d) above

rules.detail: Margin loans over SEEK Securities are not banned but require prior written clearance from the Chairman (from the ARMC Chairman for an arrangement proposed by the Chairman). Once cleared, the Disclosure Committee in consultation with the Chairman reviews the terms for materiality and SEEK may disclose the loan, its trigger points and the financier's unilateral sale rights to the market.
rules.evidence: Directors and members of the ELT must not enter into a margin loan or other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities except with prior written clearance from the Chairman, or in the case of an arrangement proposed to be entered into by the Chairman, the ARMC Chairman.

rules.tier: Members of the Executive Leadership Team
rules.detail: Same clearance requirement as Directors: prior written clearance from the Chairman. For ELT members other than the CEO the Disclosure Committee reviews materiality in consultation with the CEO; for the CEO, in consultation with the Chairman.
rules.evidence: Directors and members of the ELT must not enter into a margin loan or other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities except with prior written clearance from the Chairman

rules.detail: Section 5(A) is confined to Directors and ELT members. Designated Persons below that level (plan participants, finance and legal staff) are not subject to any margin loan restriction, although the transfer of shares into or out of a margin facility is not addressed as a dealing.

Granting security over SEEK Securities is caught by the words 'or other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities' and is permitted with prior written clearance from the Chairman, followed by a Disclosure Committee materiality review. Encumbrance is not itself defined as a dealing, so the blackout periods do not on their face bite on the grant of security, only the clearance requirement in 5(A).
rules.evidence: must not enter into a margin loan or other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities except with prior written clearance from the Chairman

rules.tier: Members of the Executive Leadership Team
rules.detail: Identical to Directors: any security arrangement over SEEK Securities requires prior written clearance from the Chairman and is then reviewed for continuous disclosure materiality by the Disclosure Committee in consultation with the CEO.
rules.evidence: Directors and members of the ELT must not enter into a margin loan or other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities except with prior written clearance from the Chairman

rules.detail: There is no blanket ban on secured financing. A loan secured on SEEK shares is an 'other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities' and is permitted with prior written clearance from the Chairman (ARMC Chairman for the Chairman), subject to materiality review and possible market disclosure of the terms.
rules.evidence: Where it is determined that the relevant margin loan or other security arrangement is material, SEEK will make a disclosure to the market in accordance with SEEK's Continuous Disclosure Policy.

rules.tier: Members of the Executive Leadership Team
rules.detail: Same regime as Directors. The Policy does not distinguish between unvested and vested shares for this purpose, but plan securities that are unvested or still subject to disposal restrictions would usually be unavailable as collateral in fact and any accompanying hedge over them is prohibited by 5(B).
rules.evidence: Directors and members of the ELT must not enter into a margin loan or other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities except with prior written clearance from the Chairman

rules.detail: Buying and selling within a three month period is restricted but not banned: it may be done with prior written clearance obtained under the Policy. A collar entered and unwound inside three months, or a short-dated collar settled physically, could be treated as short-term dealing and so needs express clearance.
rules.evidence: A Designated Person must not: (a) buy and sell SEEK Securities on a short term basis (that is, within a three month period) except with prior written clearance obtained in accordance with this Policy

clearance.approver: Chairman of the SEEK Board; for the Chairman, the Chairman of the Audit and Risk Management Committee (ARMC Chairman)
clearance.post_trade_deadline: as soon as practicable following the dealing; notice must state the number of Securities transacted and the date
clearance.evidence: where the Designated Person is a Director of SEEK, if the Director has obtained prior written clearance from the Chairman, or in the case of the Chairman, clearance from the ARMC Chairman ... As soon as practicable following any dealing in SEEK Securities by a Director of SEEK, the Director must provide written notice to the Company Secretary that the dealing has been completed.

clearance.tier: Members of the Executive Leadership Team
clearance.approver: SEEK Chief Executive Officer for ELT members other than the CEO and for the Company Secretary; the Chairman for the CEO. For dealing during a Blackout Period, the CEO clears ELT and Management
clearance.evidence: the SEEK Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for members of the ELT (other than the CEO) and the SEEK Company Secretary; and the Chairman for the CEO.

clearance.approver: SEEK Company Secretary for Designated Persons other than ELT members and the Company Secretary
clearance.evidence: the SEEK Company Secretary for Designated Persons other than members of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and the SEEK Company Secretary ... SEEK may grant or refuse clearance to trade in its absolute discretion. A clearance to trade can also be withdrawn by SEEK if new information comes to light or there is a change in circumstances.

In addition to the Insider Trading prohibitions set out in this Policy which apply to all SEEK Personnel, additional restrictions on dealing in SEEK Securities apply to Designated Persons who are specified in the Annexure to this Policy (and their Associates).

short_term.basis: buy and sell within a three month period
carve_outs: prior written clearance obtained in accordance with this Policy
short_term.evidence: buy and sell SEEK Securities on a short term basis (that is, within a three month period) except with prior written clearance obtained in accordance with this Policy

exceptions.evidence: (beneficial holdings) dealings that do not result in a change in beneficial control of SEEK Securities (for example, transferring a personal holding of SEEK Securities to a personal superannuation fund)

(third parties) an investment in, or trading in units of, a fund or other scheme (other than a scheme only investing in SEEK Securities) where the assets of the fund or scheme are invested at the discretion of a third party
(takeover) a disposal of SEEK Securities arising from a scheme of arrangement or acceptance of a takeover offer

exceptions.approver: SEEK Board of Directors approves the plan determining timing and structure
exceptions.evidence: (rights issues and equal access buy-backs) trading under an offer or invitation made to all or most of SEEK's Securityholders, such as a rights issue or equal access buy-back, where the plan that determines the timing and structure of the offer has been approved by the SEEK Board of Directors

(share purchase plans and dividend reinvestment plans) acquisition of SEEK Securities under a share purchase plan or dividend reinvestment plan, provided that Designated Persons do not commence or amend their participation in the relevant plan during a Blackout Period
(lender disposal) a disposal of SEEK Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights
(incentive scheme) the exercise (but not the sale of SEEK Securities following exercise) of an option, right or other Security under a SEEK employee incentive scheme

(employee share plan) an election to participate in, and the acquisition of SEEK Securities under, an employee share plan approved by the SEEK Board of Directors where such Securities are purchased by the Trustee of the SEEK Employee Share Trust.

exceptions.approver: CEO for ELT and Management; Chairman for the CEO and Directors; ARMC Chairman for the Chairman
exceptions.evidence: there are exceptional circumstances (such as severe financial hardship, requirements under a court order or other legal or regulatory requirements); and the Designated Person does not possess Inside Information.

exceptions.approver: CEO, Chairman or ARMC Chairman as applicable
exceptions.evidence: requirements under a court order or other legal or regulatory requirements

financing.price_trigger_guidance: Where a cleared margin loan or other security arrangement is determined to be material, SEEK's market disclosure 'will address the existence of the margin loan and set out relevant terms such as the trigger points or the right of the financier to sell unilaterally'. The Policy gives no guidance on where triggers should be set, only that they may have to be disclosed.
financing_disclosure: Directors and ELT members: at inception, prior written clearance must be sought from the Chairman (ARMC Chairman where the Chairman is the borrower) before entering any margin loan or other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities.
ELT members other than the CEO: once cleared, the Disclosure Committee in consultation with the CEO reviews the terms for materiality; no deadline stated.
CEO and Directors other than the Chairman: once cleared, the Disclosure Committee in consultation with the Chairman reviews the terms for materiality; no deadline stated.
Chairman: once cleared, the Disclosure Committee in consultation with the ARMC Chairman reviews the terms for materiality; no deadline stated.
Market: where the arrangement is determined material, SEEK discloses to the ASX under its Continuous Disclosure Policy, including trigger points and the financier's right to sell unilaterally.

external_documents: Annexure - Designated Persons (attached to the Policy)
exemption_authority: Dealing in a Blackout Period may be cleared by the CEO (for ELT and Management), the Chairman (for the CEO and Directors) or the ARMC Chairman (for the Chairman) where there are exceptional circumstances such as severe financial hardship, a court order or other legal or regulatory requirement, and the person holds no Inside Information. Section 5(A) margin loan and security arrangement clearance sits with the Chairman or, for the Chairman, the ARMC Chairman. There is no exemption power over the section 5(B) hedging ban or the short selling ban.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors and members of the ELT must not enter into a margin loan or other security arrangement in respect of SEEK Securities except with prior written clearance from the Chairman, or in the case of an arrangement proposed to be entered into by the Chairman, the ARMC Chairman.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike most ASX policies this is a consent regime rather than a ban, so the secured loan leg of a funded collar is available to Directors and ELT if the Chairman approves, and is entirely unrestricted for Designated Persons below ELT.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The following types of dealings are excluded from the operation of section 3 of this Policy and may be undertaken by Designated Persons at any time without prior notification or approval ... (lender disposal) a disposal of SEEK Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The bank's enforcement or close-out sale of the collared shares is expressly outside the blackout and clearance regime, so lender enforcement during a Blackout Period is not a breach.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Where it is determined that the relevant margin loan or other security arrangement is material, SEEK will make a disclosure to the market ... Such disclosure will address the existence of the margin loan and set out relevant terms such as the trigger points or the right of the financier to sell unilaterally.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A material funded collar loan for a Director or ELT member will be publicly disclosed including its trigger levels and the bank's unilateral sale rights, so confidentiality cannot be assumed.

bespoke_clauses.clause: arrangements which have the effect of limiting the economic risk related to an unvested share, option or other Security granted or awarded under a SEEK employee incentive scheme (or a vested share, option or other Security granted, awarded or acquired under a SEEK employee incentive scheme that is still subject to disposal restrictions).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The collar must be sized only to shares that have vested and are free of disposal restrictions; unvested and still-restricted plan shares cannot be included in the collar pool at all.

bespoke_clauses.clause: SEEK may grant or refuse clearance to trade in its absolute discretion. A clearance to trade can also be withdrawn by SEEK if new information comes to light or there is a change in circumstances.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Clearance for the collar can be revoked between approval and execution, so the bank should not treat clearance as a firm condition precedent until the trade is actually struck.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any dealing in SEEK Securities by a Designated Person in respect of which clearance is given under this section 3 must occur within 5 Trading Days of receipt of the clearance.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Pricing, documentation and execution of both derivative legs and the loan drawdown must all be completed inside five trading days of clearance, or clearance must be sought again.

bespoke_clauses.clause: A Designated Person must not: (a) buy and sell SEEK Securities on a short term basis (that is, within a three month period) except with prior written clearance obtained in accordance with this Policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar unwound or rolled within three months is not banned outright but requires separate express clearance, so short-tenor or frequently rolled structures carry extra approval risk.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Associate includes ... a trustee where the beneficiaries of the relevant trust include the Designated Person or his or her spouse, partner, child or step-child; and any other persons over whom a Designated Person ... has, or may be expected to have, investment control or influence.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Structuring the collar through a family trust or controlled company does not avoid the blackout and clearance regime, and the Designated Person must procure the associate's compliance.

bespoke_clauses.clause: additional restrictions on dealing in SEEK Securities apply to Designated Persons who are specified in the Annexure to this Policy (and their Associates).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: All equity plan participants are Designated Persons under the Annexure, so any executive holding vested plan shares will be inside the restricted population.

summary: A funded collar is possible under this policy, which is unusually permissive on the financing leg. Both derivative legs are dealings in SEEK Securities (Securities expressly includes derivatives and options with no venue limit), so a Director needs prior written clearance from the Chairman and an ELT member from the CEO, the trade must be executed within 5 Trading Days of clearance, outside the 1 December, 1 June and pre-AGM Blackout Periods and any additional period notified by the Company Secretary, and while holding no Inside Information. The secured loan leg is not banned: section 5(A) permits a margin loan or other security arrangement over SEEK Securities for Directors and ELT with prior written clearance from the Chairman (ARMC Chairman for the Chairman), after which the Disclosure Committee assesses materiality and SEEK may publicly disclose the arrangement including its trigger points and the financier's unilateral sale rights. The collar must cover only shares that have vested and are free of disposal restrictions, because section 5(B) bans any arrangement limiting the economic risk of unvested plan securities or vested plan securities still subject to disposal restrictions, and no leg may leave the executive short selling. Helpfully, a disposal resulting from a secured lender exercising its rights is an excluded dealing that may occur at any time without approval, so the bank's enforcement is not a breach even in a Blackout Period, but a collar entered and closed within three months needs additional express clearance and clearance can be withdrawn before execution.
